text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
C.B., you got a special feature... Oh!<n>And so did Teio!
Ooh! I'm gonna keep<n>this thing forever!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, you look up to<n>Teio, right? Rudolf
mentioned it to me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You bet I do! The powerful confidence<n>she runs
with comes through, even in<n>these photos.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
When I look at them, all I can think<n>about is how I
wanna reach her level<n>one day!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even if I can't catch up right now, I'll<n>keep running
for as long as it takes,<n>until we're shoulder to
shoulder!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah? Then you'll probably make it<n>into a special
feature too, before long.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Y-you think so?! ...Does that<n>mean I might get
to be interviewed<n>alongside Teio?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, C.B.! What was it like being<n>photographed with
Rudolf and so<n>many other famous Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Good question. Heh, I can't<n>say I really
remember. Guess it<n>wasn't that special to me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
W-wow! I should've guessed! If it<n>were me, I'd be
so nervous my face<n>would lock up!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah? Well, while I don't reallyremember how I felt... things like thisare fun to think about.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The time forgotten by me remains in<n>the hands of
others... Yeah. That's a<n>fun thought.
